senses.gloss:
m. (-क्षुः)
1 A sage, abstracted from all human passion and feeling, and preparing himself for eternal emancipation.
2 Any one anxious for liberation, especially from mundane existence.
E.
मुच to liberate, in the desiderative form, उ aff.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Wishing to steal.
E.
मुष to steal, desid. v., उ aff.

ind.
Like a thief.
E.
मुमु, and षिषुवति aff.

f. (-र्षा)
Wish to die, impatience of life.
E.
मृ to die, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.

m. (-र्षुः)
A man at the point of death, a dying man.
E.
मृ to die, desiderative or expectative form, and उ aff.
